verdict.rationale: Probes confirm Amplitude serves a live llms.txt at amplitude.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at amplitude.com/docs.md, both returning HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown docs and their coverage, and independent or hands-on evidence of how complete and useful the content is for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
